parameter.definition: One adjustable number inside a model. Models are described by how many parameters they have.
parameter.example: A model with more parameters can hold more patterns, but it also needs more data and more computing.

pd_accountability.definition: The answer you owe for an act, to the people affected and to the law.
pd_accountability.example: The mistake was hers, and the accountability was hers as well.

salt.definition: Coarse salt that softens the water in a dishwasher so that detergent can work. It goes in the round cap at the bottom of the tub.
salt.example: The salt symbol has come on, so I am filling the salt cap.
